original_prompt: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: yes

  vars:
    node_exporter_version: "1.3.1"
    node_exporter_port: 9100
    node_exporter_user: node_exporter
    node_exporter_group: node_exporter

  tasks:
  - name: Create node_exporter user and group
    group:
      name: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
      state: present
    user:
      name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
      group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
      system: yes
      create_home: no
      state: present

  - name: Download node_exporter binary
    get_url:
      url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-amd64.tar.gz"
      dest: "/tmp/node_exporter.tar.gz"
      mode: '0644'
    register: download

  - name: Extract node_exporter binary
    unarchive:
      src: "/tmp/node_exporter.tar.gz"
      dest: "/tmp"
      compression: tar
      interactive: yes
    when: download.changed

  - name: Copy node_exporter binary to /usr/local/bin
    copy:
      content: "{{ lookup('file', '/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-amd64/node_exporter') }}"
      dest: "/usr/local/bin/node_exporter"
      mode: '0755'
    when: download.changed

  - name: Create node_exporter systemd service file
    template:
      src: templates/node_exporter.service.j2
      dest: /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service
      mode: '0644'
    notify: restart node_exporter

  - name: Enable and start node_exporter service
    systemd:
      name: node_exporter
      state: started
      enabled: yes
      daemon_reload: yes

  handlers:
  - name: restart node_exporter
    systemd:
      name: node_exporter
      state: restarted

  - name: Create node_exporter systemd service template
    template:
      src: templates/node_exporter.service.j2
      dest: templates/node_exporter.service.j2
      mode: '0644'
    run_once: true

  - name: Create templates directory
    file:
      path: templates
      state: directory
      mode: '0755'
    run_once: true

  - name: Create node_exporter service template
    block:
      - name: Create node_exporter service template
        copy:
          content: |
            [Unit]
            Description=Node Exporter
            After=network.target

            [Service]
            User={{ node_exporter_user }}
            Group={{ node_exporter_group }}
            ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/node_exporter --web.listen-address=:{{ node_exporter_port }}
            Restart=always

            [Install]
            WantedBy=multi-user.target
          dest: templates/node_exporter.service.j2
          mode: '0644'
      - name: Set node_exporter service template
        template:
          src: templates/node_exporter.service.j2
          dest: /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service
          mode: '0644'
        notify: restart node_exporter
    when: download.changed
